rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING THE COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES TO BE KNOWN AS THE 'PHILIPPINE COOPERATIVE CODE OF 2002'
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Cooperative Code of 2004.\" The measure seeks to amend the Cooperative Code to make the organization of cooperatives more attractive and to provide a fertile social and economic environment for cooperatives to succeed in their endeavors.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04602

rows.author: E025
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING WOMEN'S PARTICIPATION IN ELECTIVE AND APPOINTIVE POSITIONS IN GOVERNMENT AS WELL AS IN GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS UNDER THE EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT
rows.title_short: Gender Balance in Political Participation and Representation Act
rows.abstract: \"Gender Balance in Political Participation and Representation Act.\" The bill proposes to implement a gender quota system to ensure that women are granted the following: a) access to appointive positions in the national and local government; and b) full participation in the electoral and political process.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN since 2004-08-30

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MODERNIZATION OF THE PHILIPPINE ATMOSPHERIC GEOPHYSICAL AND ASTRONOMICAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION (PAGASA) AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"PAG-ASA Modernization Act.\" The bill proposes the adoption of a four-pronged approach for the modernization of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration, to wit: a) modernization of physical resources and operational techniques; b) intensification of human resource development; c) upgrading of research and development capability; and d) establishment of social weather service centers in strategic cities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2004-08-30

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT STANDARDIZING PRESCHOOL EDUCATION PROGRAM PROVIDED IN BARANGAY DAY CARE CENTERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE BARANGAY-LEVEL TOTAL DEVELOPMENT AND PROTECTION OF CHILDREN ACT
rows.abstract: The bill directs the Department of Education, in coordination with the Department of Social Welfare and Development, to prepare a standard curriculum in all barangay day care centers for children 4 to 6 years old.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-30

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT ABOLISHING THE VALUE-ADDED TAX, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE TITLE IV OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to abolish the imposition of the value-added tax on goods and services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-30

rows.author: A035
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09334) enacted on 2004-12-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE RATE OF EXCISE TAXES ON CIGARS AND CIGARETTES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to raise the tax on cigars and cigarettes to generate more revenues for the government and to discourage smoking among the populace, especially the youth.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03174

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION AGAINST COMPUTER FRAUD, ABUSES AND OTHER CYBER-RELATED FRAUDULENT ACTIVITIES, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Anti-Computer Fraud and Abuses Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Computer Fraud and Abuses Act of 2004.\" The bill defines computer fraud and offenses covered by the term \"computer-related fraudulent activities.\" It provides penalties for violations of the proposed act and authorizes the National Security Council to investigate computer-related crimes vis-a-vis their effects on national security.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-01-12

rows.author: D020
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE PERIOD FROM MAY 1 TO 7 OF EVERY YEAR AS THE NATIONAL OLDER WORKERS WEEK
rows.abstract: In recognition of the contributions of workers aged 50 years and above, the bill seeks to declare May 1-7 of every year as the \"National Older Workers Week\".
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-30

rows.author: D084
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 9136, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ELECTRIC INDUSTRY REFORM ACT OF 2001
rows.abstract: Three years after the passage of the Electric Power Industry Reform Act (PERA), consumers remain at the mercy of the local electric monopolies and their independent power producers (IPPs) and foreign IPPs. Obviously, the EPIRA institutionalizes private monopoly control, perpetrates foreign domination and the exploitation of the national economy and resources at the expenses of consumers. In view of its detrimental effects on consumers and on the economy, the bill proposes the repeal of the EPIRA.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2005-05-04

rows.author: D084
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AND GUARANTEEING PUBLIC SECTOR UNIONISM IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Public Sector Unionism Act of 2004.\" The bill provides for the protection of the rights of ALL workers and employees in the public sector to: a) self-organization; b) collective bargaining and negotiations; c) peaceful concerted activities; and d) strike. It establishes the Public Sector Labor Relations Board which shall have original and exclusive jurisdiction to hear and decide on all cases arising from the proposed act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-30

rows.author: E047
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE RIGHTS OF FARMERS TO LAND AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Farmers' Land Rights Act.\" The bill imposes the direct right of farmers to the land they till to ensure their security of tenure and therefor be more productive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 2004-08-30

rows.author: E014
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR VACATION AND SICK LEAVE BENEFITS TO PRIVATE SECTOR EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 442 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: For clarity, the bill seeks to abolish the service incentive leave granted under Section 95 of the Labor Code and, in lieu thereof, provide for both vacation and sick leave benefits to private sector employees and make said benefits mandatory.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-31

rows.abstract: The bill sets the probationary employment period of academic personnel as follows: a) one (1) calendar year of very satisfactory service for those in the elementary and secondary levels; b) two consecutive regular semesters of very satisfactory service for those in the tertiary levels; and c) three consecutive trimester of very satisfactory service for those in the tertiary level with a trimester program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING A NEGLIGENT LESSOR OF A BUILDING, WAREHOUSE, OR ANY EDIFICE FOUND TO BE USED IN THE MANUFACTURE OR STORAGE OF DANGEROUS DRUGS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9165, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COMPREHENSIVE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 2002
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to impose a penalty of imprisonment from 12 years and 1 day to 20 years and a fine ranging from P100,000 to P500,000 on the owner of a building, warehouse or any edifice whose property is used for the manufacture or storage of dangerous drugs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE REGISTRATION OF PRE-PAID SIM CARD USERS AND MOBILE PHONE UNITS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill requires public telecommunication entities to establish a foolproof system of identifying users and/or purchasers of pre-paid SIM (subscription identification module) cards in order to contain the theft of mobile telephone units.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-02-02

rows.author: C039
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09396) enacted on 2007-03-18
rows.title_full: AN ACT REFEDINING THE TERM 'VETERAN' THEREBY AMENDING FURTHER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6948 AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill defines a war veteran as \"any person who rendered military service in the land, sea or air forces of the Philippines when the Philippines was at war and foreign nationals who served in the Philippine forces. A veteran of a military campaign is any person who became part of the Philippine expeditionary forces sent abroad or who participated in a military campaign so designated by the President of the Philippines.\"
rows.status: Substituted by HB04451

rows.author: C039
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SYSTEM OF PAYING THE ARREARS OF PENSION TO VETERANS, PENALIZING ANY FRAUD COMMITTED IN RELATION TO THIS ACT
rows.abstract: The bill entitles all veterans, whose disability is rated from 91% to 100%, to receive a Certificate of Indebtedness amounting to P30,000. The Certificate shall be issued in lieu of the monthly pension of P1,700 plus P500 for the spouse and each unmarried minor child.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on 2005-05-24

rows.abstract: The bill mandates the Commission on Audit to conduct a pre-audit examination of all expenditures and uses of public funds pertaining to infrastructure projects and the procurement of goods and consulting services.

rows.author: C136
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE NATIONAL LAND USE POLICY AND PLANNING FRAME WORK AND THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISM THEREFOR, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL LAND USE ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: National Land Use Act of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"National Land Use Act of the Philippines.\" The bill seeks to address issues relative to the allocation and utilization of all lands, whether private or government-owned, including minerals and water therein. It proposes to adopt the following land use categories: a) protection land use; b) production land use; c) settlements development; and d) infrastructure development.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-31

rows.author: C136
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR SUSTAINABLE MANAGEMENT OF FOREST RESOURCES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Sustainable Management of Forest Resources Act of 1998
rows.abstract: \"The Sustainable Management of Forest Resources Act of 1998.\" The bill provides for the limits and classification of forestlands; administration and management of these areas; forest protection; disposition and utilization of forest resources; forest charges, fees and rentals; and criminal offenses and penalties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-08-31

rows.author: C136
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A COMPREHENSIVE WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT TO ADDRESS THE NATIONAL WATER CRISIS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Water Resources Management Act of 1998
rows.abstract: \"The Water Resources Management Act of 1998.\" The bill provides for the creation of the Water Resources Authority of the Philippines which shall be responsible for the formulation of a national framework for water resources management based on a decentralized, community-based and participatory approach. It defines the powers and functions and organizational structure of the Authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-08-31

rows.author: E018
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SEAWEED INSTITUTE AT THE ILOILO STATE COLLEGE OF FISHERIES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING CALAYAN RAIL LOCALLY KNOWN AS 'PIDING' AS A PROTECTED BIRD IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FOR THE PRESERVATION OF THE SAME AND AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATIONS OF FUNDS FOR THE PURPOSE
rows.abstract: \"Calayan Rail Act.\" The bill seeks to declare the Calayan rail or \"piding\" as an endangered specie to save it from extinction.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05132

rows.author: E034
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING RETIREMENT, DEATH, DISABILITY AND OTHER BENEFITS FOR THE PROSECUTORS AND THE LEGAL STAFF OF THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to upgrade the retirement, gratuity, death, disability, survivorship and other benefits granted to public prosecutors and the legal staff of the Department of Justice.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-31

rows.author: E034
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING ADDITIONAL RETIREMENT BENEFITS TO MEMBERS OF THE JUDICIARY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 910, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to upgrade the retirement benefits granted to the members of the Judiciary. It also seeks to redefine the retirement condition on the length of service to the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-08-31

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING AND RENAMING THE PHILIPPINE RETIREMENT PARK SYSTEM, ENLARGING ITS POWERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Retirement Authority.\" The bill seeks to rename the Philippine Retirement Park System to Philippine Retirement Authority. Likewise, the measure provides for the powers and functions, organizational structure, incentives and benefits, and capitalization of the Authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2004-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A STRONGER AND ACCOUNTABLE INVOLVEMENT OF SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN IN LOCAL AFFAIRS AND NATION-BUILDING, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The measure aims to give the sangguniang kabataan (SK) fiscal autonomy and independence in its operations as to disbursements and encashment of their income and expenses. It redefines and rationalizes the duties and responsibilities of SK members vis-a-vis their own constituents in the youth sector.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-31

rows.author: D060
rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING THE CATANDUANES NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL ANNEX IN BARANGAY TIBANG, CALATAGAN, MUNICIPALITY OF VIRAC, PROVINCE OF CATANDUANES FROM THE CATANDUANES NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, THEREBY CONVERTING THE SAME INTO AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, TO BE KNOWN AS THE CALATAGAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-31

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on YOUTH AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT since 2004-08-31

rows.author: D060
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE AND REGULATE THE CABLE TELEVISION SERVICES IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Cable TV Act of 2001.\" The bill seeks to lay down the legal basis for the entry of capital, acquisition of state-of-the-art CATV technology, transmission, programming and production. It rationalizes the regulation of the cable television industry by clearly delineating the powers of the regulating body and the rights of the cable television operators.
rows.status: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2006-08-08

committee_action.action: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2006-08-08

rows.author: D060
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09340) enacted on 2005-09-22
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TERM OF BARANGAY AND SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN OFFICIALS AND SETTING THE DATE OF ITS ELECTION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT 9164
rows.abstract: The bill proposes the holding of the synchronized barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections on the 2nd Monday of May 2007 to coincide with the national and local officials and every three years thereafter. It also extends the terms of those elected on July 15 2002 to June 30, 2007.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03742

rows.author: C122
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09367) enacted on 2007-01-12
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE THE USE OF ETHYL ALCOHOL OR ETHANOL AS ALTERNATIVE TRANSPORT FUEL, ESTABLISHING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL FUEL ETHANOL PROGRAM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Fuel Ethanol Act of 2004.\" The bill encourages and promotes the use of ethyl alcohol or ethanol as an alternative transport fuel through the Fuel Ethanol Program. The Program shall introduce the production of ethanol from sugarcane, corn, or cassava.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04629

rows.author: E023
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09439) enacted on 2007-04-27
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE REFUSAL OF HOSPITALS, MEDICAL INSTITUTIONS AND OTHER MEDICAL CLINICS TO RELEASE PATIENTS AND CORPSE OF PATIENTS DUE TO INABILITY TO PAY HOSPITAL EXPENSES AS SERIOUS ILLEGAL DETENTION AMENDING ART. 267 OF ACT NO. 3815 AS AMENDED OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: The bill imposes the penalty of reclusion perpetua to death to owners of hospitals, medical institutions/clinics that detain or refuse to release patients confined due to non-payment of hospital expenses.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB00068

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE COMMISSION ON PRE-SCHOOL EDUCATION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: The Commission on Pre-School Education Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Commission on Pre-School Education Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to create the Commission on Preparatory School Education, define its powers and functions and appropriate the necessary funding for its establishment and operation.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-08-17

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-08-17

rows.author: B031
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE INCENTIVES TO ALL BARANGAY OFFICIALS, INCLUDING BARANGAY TANODS AND MEMBERS OF THE LUPON NG TAGAPAMAYAPA, AND EMPLOYEES OF THE BARANGAY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Barangay Incentives Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to grant barangay officials, including barangay tanods and members of the lupong tagapamayapa, the following incentive: a) exemption from income, capital gains and transfer taxes; b) GSIS coverage; c) health benefits; and d) legal representation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-31

rows.author: B031
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-08-07, transmitted to on 2006-08-14 and received by the Senate on 2006-08-14
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS TO RETAIN AND UTILIZE THEIR INCOME FOR MAINTENANCE AND OTHER OPERATING EXPENSES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill authorizes all government hospitals, including medical centers and specialty hospitals, to retain and use their income for maintenance and other operating expenses, including capital outlay.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04375

rows.author: B031
rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2006-12-11
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE DRINKING WATER BUSINESS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Drinking Water Business Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to regulate the business of producing and selling mineral, pure and distilled water to protect the health of consumers.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05913

rows.author: D060
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO INCLUDE VEHICLE TRAFFIC EDUCATION AS PART OF THE EDUCATIONAL CURRICULUM IN THE ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY LEVEL, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill authorizes the Department of Education to include in the curriculum of elementary and high schools the teaching of basic vehicle traffic rules as part of the values education subject.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-31

rows.author: E047
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SECURITY OF TENURE OF FARMERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Farmers Security of Tenure Act.\" The bill requires the preliminary determination of cases involving disputes or controversies between farmers and landlords by the Department of Agrarian Reform before a regular court can take cognizance of such cases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 2004-08-31
